content.title: Oil and Gas Economics
content.abstract: The textbook is intended for undergraduate students studying economics and management, and is used in the course “Economics and Business Planning in Oil and Gas Companies”. The publication is aimed to provide a systematic overview of the oil and gas industry functioning as well as the principles of managing oil and gas companies. The first part of the book examines the industry-specific features of the oil and gas economy. It presents the historical stages of development of the industry, analyzes the dynamics of key indicators and reveals the properties and classifications of hydrocarbons. Spe
